subject: Suggestion : add for navbarPage() something like navPanel() but inactive

messages.author: 4753f061948056b3
messages.subject: Suggestion : add for navbarPage() something like navPanel() but inactive
parts:
Hi,

I play actually mith the navbarPage() layout, in a exemple of multi language app : French, English, Dutch.
The topic is pigeon racing in Belgium.
App available here : http://www.yapluka.be/sapps/beprmap/
Code available here : https://github.com/gvincke/beprmap

For a pleasant user experience, language must be selectable easely, within every tabs of the app.

This is not possible if the select widget is set in a particularly page. If we change of page using one of the tab of the navbar, the select list of available language is lost.

The only solution i found is to use the header attribute of navbarPage(), and set the position of this widget using CSS over the navbarPage().

Look at lines 21, 44 and 45 of https://github.com/gvincke/beprmap/blob/master/ui.R

This solution works, but is not very cool, because this select list is over the navbar (z-index:1001) and with position absolute to right border of the page. So if the screen gets smaller, the selec list will be placed over tabs. Not cool.

My suggestion is that it could be sooo cool if a other kind of tab than tabPanel() can be defined for navbarPage(). A tab wich is not "active" : i mean a li element  wich is not inside a link (no <a ></a> tags arround). The aim will be to put there small information like licence, authorship, or widgets. It's exactly the same than the title tab of navbarPage(), so it must'nt be hard to implement. One of the advantage is that this tab will be in the same z-index thant others.

Thanks for paying atention to this request.

Best regards.

Grégoire
